item.title: Krea for Premiere Pro: AI Shots, Inserts and Plates Straight Into Your Timeline
item.description: Krea for Premiere Pro generates shots, inserts, and plates inside your edit. Results land as regular media you can trim and grade.

item.title: Krea for Photoshop: The AI Plugin for Generating, Relighting and Swapping Backgrounds
item.description: Krea for Photoshop is a Photoshop plugin for AI image and video generation, background replacement, relighting, and multi-shot layouts. Results land as layers.

item.title: Krea for Illustrator: Generate Artwork, Vectorize It and Design with Krea Agent
item.description: Krea for Illustrator generates artwork, turns it into editable paths with Image Trace, and designs in the document with Krea Agent.

item.title: Krea for DaVinci Resolve: AI Look Development, Plates and Grade References
item.description: Krea for DaVinci Resolve builds looks, plates, and grade references. It requires macOS 12 or later and DaVinci Resolve Studio. Windows is coming.

item.title: Krea for Blender: The AI Add
item.description: Krea for Blender is an AI add-on for materials, lighting, and render exploration in the 3D Viewport. It needs Blender 5.2 or later.

item.title: Krea for After Effects: Generate Plates, Backgrounds and Motion Concepts Inside Your Comp
item.description: Krea for After Effects generates plates, backgrounds, and motion concepts inside your composition. It needs After Effects 2025 or newer.

item.title: Krea 3 vs Nano Banana Pro (2026): Ahead on Every Leaderboard
item.description: Krea 3 ranks above Nano Banana Pro on Arena (1435 vs 1365), Design Arena (1298 vs 1245), and Artificial Analysis (Ultra 1151 and Fast 1125 vs 1106). It is 10× faster, 3× cheaper, compared to GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro.

item.description: Krea 3 Ultra leads on Artificial Analysis (1151 vs GPT Image 2 (high) 1136) while GPT Image 2 leads on Arena and Design Arena. Krea 3 is 10× faster, 3× cheaper, compared to GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro.
